basic_details.job_title: GSL Assistant Superintendent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL), a Government of India Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, will fill 4 regular non-executive posts under Advt. No. 10/2026: 2 Assistant Superintendent (Personal Secretary) and 2 Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial), on pay scale 21000-3%-70000 (S-1). Online applications open at 00.00 hrs on 25 November 2026 and close at 17.00 hrs on 24 December 2026 at www.goashipyard.in. The application fee is Rs. 200; SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and internal candidates are exempted.

application_fee.sc_fee: Exempted, as per Government of India rules
application_fee.details: The fee is paid online through SBI e-pay (debit card, credit card, net banking etc.). An application without the prescribed fee is liable for rejection. Candidates who pay a lesser amount or use any other mode will be rejected. The fee paid by ineligible candidates is forfeited and no correspondence is entertained.

age_limit.details: Ex-Servicemen/Agniveer and PwBD candidates: relaxation as per existing Government guidelines, as amended from time to time. Internal candidates: age relaxation as per GSL rules. After all relaxations, the maximum age on the cut-off date must not be more than 56 years. | Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveer can also apply if they fulfil the eligibility criteria; their candidature is considered as per Government guidelines in vogue. Concessions and relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates as per Government guidelines. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the online system. The online window opens on 25 November 2026 and closes on 24 December 2026 at 17.00 hrs.
Visit www.goashipyard.in and, under the link Notice Board – 'careers', click 'GSL Careers'.
Click the 'Apply Now' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
Keep scanned copies of the listed documents ready before starting the form.
After completing personal information, fill the payment details and pay the Rs. 200 fee online through SBI e-pay, where applicable.
Wait for the server's intimation and do not press back or refresh, to avoid double charges.
Download and print the fee receipt. If no fee receipt is generated, the payment has failed; log in again and repeat the payment.
Tick the Terms & Conditions check box and click submit. Application details cannot be edited after submission.
Take a print-out of the auto-generated application form, which must be produced at the subsequent selection process.
Passport size colour photograph with light background (preferably white), face and eyes unobstructed; file below 450 kb.
Signature on plain white paper with black ink, scanned from your own signature (not digitalized); file below 450 kb.
SSC certificate as proof of date of birth: not more than 500 kb.
Educational qualification marksheet and degree: not more than 1 Mb.
Caste / Disability / Ex-Serviceman certificate: not more than 500 kb.
Experience certificates: not more than 1 Mb.
Online transaction receipt and Aadhar Card: each not more than 500 kb.

Reserved category candidates must submit the caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for "Appointment to posts under the Government of India". It must show the caste, the Act/Order recognising it as SC/ST/OBC (NCL) and the Village/Town of ordinary residence. EWS candidates must submit the EWS certificate. PwBD candidates must submit the disability certificate under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, showing the percentage of disability. A certificate in a language other than English/Hindi needs a self-certified translation in English or Hindi.

content_sections.heading: About GSL
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited is a Government of India Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, located at Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa. The notice describes it as a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna Category I Company engaged in designing and building ships for the Indian Navy, the Indian Coast Guard and other customers, including friendly foreign countries.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 4 vacancies in total. It states that they include backlog reserved vacancies. Reserved category candidates who meet the eligibility criteria may also apply for the posts earmarked for UR, as per Government rules. A reserved category candidate applying for a post with no vacancies in their own category is treated as a General candidate, and no relaxation in any criteria applies to such candidates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens who meet the eligibility requirements may apply. Upper age limit and experience are counted as on 31.10.2026. Essential experience: 5 years relevant post qualification (after graduation) work experience in Secretarial functions. Desirable experience: candidates with working experience with senior level officers in government / public sector companies / private companies as Personal Secretary or providing secretarial assistance shall be preferred. Desirable language skill: adequate working knowledge of Konkani / Marathi along with Hindi & English. Upper age limit: 36 years (UR). Essential experience: minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience. Desirable language skill: adequate working knowledge of Konkani / Marathi along with Hindi & English. Upper age limit: 38 years (ST). Ex-Servicemen/Agniveer and PwBD candidates: relaxation as per existing Government guidelines, as amended from time to time. Internal candidates: age relaxation as per GSL rules. After all relaxations, the maximum age on the cut-off date must not be more than 56 years. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveer can also apply if they fulfil the eligibility criteria; their candidature is considered as per Government guidelines in vogue. Concessions and relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates as per Government guidelines. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate in any discipline with computer typing speed of 30 w.p.m.
rows.desirable: Diploma in Secretarial Practice and / or a certificate course in shorthand with speed 80 w.p.m.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) OR Graduate in any discipline with Diploma in Commercial / Supply Chain Management / Materials management / Logistics management / other relevant qualification equivalent to 01-year Diploma in Material Management from a recognized University / Institute.
rows.desirable: 2 years Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Commercial / Supply Chain Management from a recognized University / Institute.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry the pay scale 21000-3%-70000 (S-1). The posts are filled on regular basis. The notice does not mention allowances.

Candidates who pay a lesser amount or use any other mode will be rejected. The fee paid by ineligible candidates is forfeited and no correspondence is entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a written test, Document Verification and a Skill/Trade test. The written test may be a Computer based Test (CBT) or Pen Paper based Test (PBT), conducted internally or externally depending on the number of shortlisted candidates. It will normally consist of 25% General Aptitude and 75% subject/trade related questions. *Where the post is reserved for the respective category.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 for Assistant Superintendent (Personal Secretary), reserved UR, and 2 for Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial), reserved ST. They include backlog reserved vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSL Advt. No. 10/2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes at 17.00 hrs on 24 December 2026. It opens at 00.00 hrs on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Personal Secretary post?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline with computer typing speed of 30 w.p.m., plus 5 years' relevant post-qualification (after graduation) experience in Secretarial functions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Stores/Commercial post?
faq.answer: Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) OR a graduate in any discipline with a Diploma in Commercial / Supply Chain Management / Materials management / Logistics management or an equivalent qualification, with minimum 2 years' relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 31.10.2026 is 36 years (UR) for Personal Secretary and 38 years (ST) for Stores/Commercial. After all relaxations the maximum age must not exceed 56 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Both posts carry the pay scale 21000-3%-70000 (S-1).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee and who is exempted?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200 (non-refundable), paid online through SBI e-pay. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted, and internal candidates pay no fee.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.goashipyard.in under Notice Board – 'careers' – 'GSL Careers' – 'Apply Now'. Applications by any other mode are not considered.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection consists of a written test, Document Verification and a Skill/Trade test. Written test weightage is 75% and skill test 25%.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent and where will the posting be?
faq.answer: The posts are filled on regular basis. Posting is at GSL, any other GSL units or project sites, and candidates are liable to be transferred.
